findings.claim: When the judge reverts an auto-applied change (L42, and the casual-lockout revert at L41) it is told to 'set its proposal entry to rejected', but smine-apply removes every implemented proposal (auto-applied included) from proposals/<kind>.json and archives it to archive/done.md with an (auto) marker. There is no proposal entry left to mark, so the reverted change stays recorded as implemented in done.md and the required 'mark the proposal rejected' outcome (correctness-49) never lands.
findings.evidence: Re-read smine-apply SKILL.md L31 (step 4 ends: 'Render the proposal into archive/done.md with a completion note, then remove it from <kind>.json in place'), L36 (auto-apply SAFE candidates are implemented 'per kind exactly as step 4') and L37 (done.md entries get an '(auto)' marker). Re-read smine-orchestrate SKILL.md L41-42: both revert paths say to set the proposal entry, or the driving proposal, to rejected. Neither file names archive/done.md → archive/rejected.md as the place to record the rejection. Sequence: in decide mode, smine-apply auto-applies a skills edit, so the entry is gone from skills.json and appended to done.md (auto). The wrapper commits. Orchestrate judges it bad, reverts the edit on the branch, then finds no entry in skills.json to set to rejected. After the merge, done.md still reports the change as implemented although the code no longer has it. done.md also feeds the dimension skills' permanent suppression and smine-apply's already-present check, so the false 'done' is never corrected.
findings.fix: In smine-orchestrate L41-42, record the rejection where apply left the proposal: move its archive/done.md entry to archive/rejected.md with status rejected, the reason and the decided date (fall back to setting status in <kind>.json only when the entry is still there).

findings.claim: Concept audit (ACTION-REVIEW-SPEC-005): three mechanisms this diff adds to the smine pipeline trace to none of the 14 supplied specs. They are the pre-run Drift stage (session-mine.js L95-110, smine changelog 1.12), the model/effort tier override spread into every agent() call (L31-35, changelog 1.13), and the --subagents flag with its Subagent-mining section (smine SKILL.md L32, smine-batch SKILL.md L29/L69-73, session-mine.js L29/L116). The smine-permissions dimension is excluded here because the known ledger already carries it.
findings.evidence: Grepped all 14 spec copies for '--subagents', 'drift stage', 'ledger drift', 'model/effort' and 'session_get': no match. The base-to-head diff of session-mine.js shows the Drift phase, DRIFT_SCHEMA, the tier spread and the subagents arg as additions. smine-batch's diff adds the --subagents arg and the 'Subagent mining (opt-in)' section.
